title: The Office User system role is non-editable (lock icon, eye only)
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Roles & Permissions list.
custom_steps:
1. Find the Office User row.
  2. Look at the role name column.
  3. Look at the Actions column.
  4. Click the eye icon.
custom_expected:
A lock icon shows next to Office User.

The Actions column has only the eye icon — no pencil, no three-dot menu.

The eye opens a read-only Permission Summary for Office User.
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs live list); Office User editable=false verified
